```cardsmith
card:
  system: daggerheart
  card-type: environment
  language: en
data:
  # The card's name, shown as the title on the front. Falls back to the note's file name when unset.
  name: Ambushed

  # The card's text — Markdown; a feature's name in bold, as the cards print it.
  description: |-
    **Relative Strength – Passive:** The Difficulty of this environment equals that of the adversary with the highest Difficulty.
  
    *Who cues the ambush? What makes it clear they're in charge?*
  
    **Surprise! – Action:** The ambushers reveal themselves to the party, you gain 2 Fear, and the spotlight immediately shifts to one of the ambushing adversaries.
  
    *What do the ambushers want from the party? How do their tactics in the ambush reflect that?*

  # Empty boxes to tick off with a pen. A number (`20`), a labelled row (`{ count: 20, label: Arrows }`) or a list of such rows. `group` (default 5) sets how many boxes stand together.
  tracker: # no sample

  # The tier, 1 to 4.
  tier: 1

  # The type — Exploration, Social, Traversal or Event.
  type: Event

  # The one-line description, in italics under the head.
  blurb: An ambush is set to catch an unsuspecting party off-guard.

  # The impulses — what the place pushes toward, comma-separated.
  impulses: Overwhelm, scatter, surround

  # The Difficulty — a number, or "Special".
  difficulty: Special

  # The potential adversaries — groups with their members in brackets, or "Any".
  potential-adversaries: Any
```
